text_claims.claim_zh: 海淀分局通告记录：2022—2035 年版本草案于 2024-12-19 至 2025-01-19 网上公示，并对反馈意见进行了研究与采纳说明。
text_claims.claim_en: The Haidian Branch notice records that a 2022-2035 draft was displayed online from 2024-12-19 to 2025-01-19 and documents consideration of public feedback.

text_claims.claim_zh: 北京日报经人民网转载报道称，2024—2035 年版本街区控规已获批。
text_claims.claim_en: A Beijing Daily report republished by People.cn states that the 2024-2035 street-block regulatory plan was approved.

text_claims.claim_zh: 报道给出的文字范围为东至新街口外大街、西至中关村大街、北至成府路、南至西直门外大街，共 9 个街区、总用地面积约 1668.2 公顷。
text_claims.claim_en: The report gives textual bounds from Xinjiekouwai Street east to Zhongguancun Street west, Chengfu Road north to Xizhimenwai Street south, covering nine blocks and approximately 1,668.2 hectares.

text_claims.claim_zh: 报道概括的空间结构为“一带一轴、两心多点”：京张铁路遗址公园产业创新带、中关村大街创新发展轴、大钟寺与五道口两中心及知春路、四道口等节点。
text_claims.claim_en: The report summarizes a one-belt, one-axis, two-centres, multiple-nodes structure: the Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park innovation belt, Zhongguancun Street innovation axis, Dazhongsi and Wudaokou centres, and nodes including Zhichun Road and Sidaokou.

version_delta.required_action: Retain both labels with their source dates; do not silently normalize or infer amendment history.

alignment_decisions.reported_plan_signal: railway-heritage-park green public space and industrial innovation belt
alignment_decisions.submission_response: Retain the Co-op Line along the heritage park as a public-interest service and cooperation layer.
alignment_decisions.boundary: This is not official endorsement, land allocation or a new statutory belt.

alignment_decisions.reported_plan_signal: Dazhongsi identified as one of two centres
alignment_decisions.submission_response: Retain DAZHONGSI-MVP-01 as the single spatial-operational rehearsal focus.
alignment_decisions.boundary: PROV-KEY-003 is not the official Dazhongsi-centre boundary and cannot be snapped to the report.

alignment_decisions.reported_plan_signal: north-south and east-west walking and cycling connectivity around the park
alignment_decisions.submission_response: Retain the no-data-equivalent walking and cycling line and public east-west stitches as design priorities.
alignment_decisions.boundary: No route, crossing, entrance, right-of-way or accessibility performance is confirmed.

alignment_decisions.reported_plan_signal: reuse of old factories and renewal of inefficient buildings
alignment_decisions.submission_response: Retain survey-first adaptive reuse and reversible test fits instead of presuming demolition or new build.
alignment_decisions.boundary: No real building, owner, permission, capacity, cost or implementation timing is confirmed.

evidence_boundary.statement_zh: 本轮只把分层文本事实变成可审计设计依据；不把报道数字写入 metrics，不从文字四至绘制 polygon，不把获批报道解释为本方案获批、政府背书或实施承诺。
evidence_boundary.statement_en: This round turns tiered textual facts into an auditable design basis only. It does not place reported figures in metrics, digitize a polygon from textual bounds, or treat reported plan approval as approval, government endorsement, or implementation of this submission.
